pageDescription: Master data, domains and subscription for {tenant}.
tenantIdHelp: Needed, for example, to share a photo album with this organization.
statusUnreachableHint: The domain no longer pointed to hocX at the last check — check your DNS records
deleteDomainConfirm: Permanently delete domain "{hostname}"? Access through this address ends immediately.
emptyDomainDescription: Connect a domain like app.your-club.com so members can reach hocX under your own address. Verification happens via a DNS record.
emptyDomainHintWithFeature: Until then, the organization stays reachable at the default address.
emptyDomainHintWithoutFeature: Custom domains must be added to your plan (tab "Plan & usage"). Until then, the organization stays reachable at the default address.
domainsDescription: Custom domains for the hocX app, the submission box and the verification page. hocx.example.com and the default submission box domain always stay reachable too.
wizardDescription: Connect a custom domain for this organization in three steps.
wizardPurposeAppDescription: Open the regular hocX interface under your own domain.
wizardPurposeAbgabeboxDescription: Make the public submission box reachable under your own domain.
removeDomainConfirm: Permanently delete domain "{domain}"? DNS setup will need to be restarted afterwards.
dnsIntro: Set two records for {domain} with your domain provider, then verify. hocx.example.com and the default submission box domain always stay reachable too.
successAppDescription: The hocX app is now also reachable under this domain.
successAbgabeboxDescription: The submission box is now also reachable under this domain.
subscriptionLoadFailed: Subscription data could not be loaded.
legacyPlanNote: Carried over from the previous system — no limits on users or storage.
saveSuccessVerificationRevoked: Saved. Because the name changed, the verification by hocX was revoked (Templates → Authenticity check).
wizardPurposeVerifyDescription: Let people verify your documents under your own address, e.g. verify.club.com.
successVerifyDescription: New PDFs now point to this verification page, as long as name and logo are shown on the verification page (document verification).

privacy.intro: Decide who sees which personal data. Applies to all members of this organisation.
privacy.statisticsPerPersonPublic: Fines and attendance per person visible to everyone
privacy.statisticsPerPersonPublicHint: Off: members with read access only see their own figures in the statistics. Writers, treasurers and admins always see everyone.

export.title: Club export
export.description: All club data for further use: Excel tables (members, events, attendance, fines, finances, tasks, lists), the PDFs of closed minutes and optionally photos, submissions and documents as original files. Without credentials. The export is created in the background and can be downloaded for 7 days. Requires a sign-in confirmed with two-factor authentication.
export.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. Stored encrypted only until the export is created – without the password the file cannot be opened.
export.hint: AES-256 encrypted. Open with e.g. 7-Zip (Windows), Keka (macOS) or WinRAR.
export.queued: The export is being created. You can leave this page.
export.failed: The export could not be started.
export.missingFiles: {count, plural, one {# file was missing} other {# files were missing}}

activity.intro: Changes, sign-ins and accesses by the hocX platform to this organisation's data. Without IP or email addresses.

retention.intro: Decide how long the club keeps certain data. All rules are off until you switch them on. hocX suggests matching entries every day; you confirm or dismiss them. Former members are only deactivated, never deleted.

submissions_months.label: Delete upload box submissions after the deadline
submissions_months.hint: Applies to submissions with a deadline. The submitted files and their previews are deleted.

former_members_years.label: Deactivate former members after they leave
former_members_years.hint: Login is blocked and running sessions end. Name, attendance, fines and minutes stay unchanged.

unlinked_gallery_years.label: Suggest old gallery images without album or event

retention.autoApply: Apply suggestions for submissions and former members automatically
retention.autoApplyHint: Gallery images always remain a suggestion. Every action is listed in the activity log.
retention.applyConfirm: {count, plural, one {Apply one suggestion?} other {Apply # suggestions?}} Submissions and gallery images are deleted permanently, members are deactivated.
